title: mspp_redirect
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): mspp_createdby, mspp_modifiedby, mspp_sitemarkerid, mspp_webpageid, mspp_websiteid.

mspp_createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

mspp_inboundurl.description: The path to redirect visitors from

mspp_modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was modified.

mspp_name.description: The name of the custom entity.

mspp_redirecturl.description: The path to redirect visitors to

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Redirect

_mspp_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_mspp_sitemarkerid_value.description: Unique identifier for Site Marker associated with Redirect.

_mspp_webpageid_value.description: Unique identifier for Web Page associated with Redirect.

_mspp_websiteid_value.description: Unique identifier for Website associated with Redirect.
